verdict.rationale: Fathom documents first-party API endpoints that return your meeting data. You can list meetings, fetch transcripts and summaries directly, and request a downloadable recording file delivered via a signed URL. Admins can also read all shared meetings. Getting everything out still means scripting per-recording API calls, and the docs never name the file formats or describe a complete export path. Missing for 10: a one-step bulk 'export all data' feature, documented open file formats for transcripts, summaries and recordings, coverage of all data types (comments, clips, playlists, settings), and independent or hands-on confirmation of a full export.
